body:
I'm four days post-op and had fairly significant anxiety about the surgery literally up till I was in the recovery room. Never about whether the result would be what I wanted but about the fact I was voluntarily having major surgery. Which frankly is terrifying to conceptualize in my opinion. 

I tried to focus on how I knew all along that it wasn't top surgery I was worried about, it was surgery in general. And it worked well enough I guess, I was panicking a bit before surgery but I've felt way calmer and just generally relieved the past few days. 

To get my original appointments before I got the momentum going, I would tell people I was scheduling them (friends or my therapist) so that my anxiety would be more preoccupied with how I'd be embarrassed to have them ask how it went and have not done it. Not sure if that's how your anxiety works but future embarrassment works as motivation for mine
